_instructions_DO_NOT_EDIT: START HERE. These are instructions only; do not enter your configuration values in this section.
Edit only the value members inside _operator_inputs_EDIT below. Keep each adjacent _comment as its explanation. The workflow creates the job ID from episode and confirmed_title; do not supply one.

This is a no-DVD intake example. Confirm the Archive item and title for this job; do not reuse sample decisions. This template supports only explicit no-DVD intake. For DVD-backed intake, create a separate plan with --dvd and the exact matching DVD path.
No-DVD mode has no DVD-derived 5.1/SRT and cannot pass external absolute A/V correlation; it uses the separate LD-only duration/PAD timing route.

For no-DVD jobs, cut_pad_images must be use or skip when shared stills are available. use permits a uniquely verified still only for a confirmed cut-PAD frame; skip forbids those stills, so later cut-PAD repair must use the documented hold-cut method. Neither choice permits cross-shot RIFE.
The intake ends after input validation. Review the initialized manifest's episode/title identity before creating a processing plan.
For shared mode, resolve the device episode workspace first and set manifest_path to that workspace's manifest/SxxExx.json.
The runner fills approved_by from the current local account and approved_at_utc from the workflow start time; do not enter either value.

episode._comment: Required. SxxExx code confirmed against the selected Archive item.

profile._comment: Required. Absolute path to this machine's external device-local machine profile. Keep the profile outside the release tree.

archive_url._comment: Required. Confirmed Archive item URL; its episode identity must match episode above.

downloads_dir._comment: Required. Exact intended download folder on a volume with sufficient free space.

confirmed_title._comment: Required audit choice. Confirm from the DVD/capture evidence; after initialization, verify the manifest title matches.

dvd_mode._comment: This intake template supports only the explicit no-dvd choice. DVD-backed intake requires a separate plan passing --dvd with the exact matching DVD path. No-DVD means LD-only timing, no DVD 5.1/SRT, and no external absolute A/V correlation.

cut_pad_images._comment: No-DVD choice when shared cut-PAD stills are available: use allows a curated, uniquely matched still only for a confirmed cut-PAD; skip forbids stills and uses hold-cut for a confirmed cut-PAD. Stills never replace a DVD reference or other video/audio.

manifest_path._comment: Required. Absolute expected manifest path. In shared mode, resolve the device episode workspace and use its manifest folder.
